title: Congratulations to the SDSE 2026 Poster Award Team!
summary: Congratulations to Iqra Shaheen and our collaborators on receiving an Honorable Mention poster award at SDSE 2026 for our work on vanadium redox flow battery electrodes!
paragraphs: Congratulations to Iqra Shaheen and our collaborators on receiving an Honorable Mention poster award at SDSE 2026!

Our poster, “Nanostructured g-C3N4-Decorated Graphite Felt Electrodes for Enhanced Redox Kinetics in Vanadium Redox Flow Batteries,” was presented at the 4th International Conference on Smart Devices and Sustainable Energy in New Taipei City, Taiwan, on 14–16 October 2026.
This work was a collaboration among Iqra Shaheen, Yu-Xian Lee, Wei-Hao Chiu, Shih-Hsuan Chen, and Kun-Mu Lee. Congratulations to everyone involved!

title: Congratulations to Prof. Kun-Mu Lee and Dr. Wei-Hao Chiu on the Chemical Engineering Masterpiece Award!
summary: Congratulations to Prof. Kun-Mu Lee and Dr. Wei-Hao Chiu on receiving the Chemical Engineering Masterpiece Award! Our Frontier Materials Research Group (FMRG) team also shared recent research at the 2025 TwIChE annual meeting in Tainan.
paragraphs: A happy milestone for our team—congratulations to Prof. Kun-Mu Lee and Dr. Wei-Hao Chiu on receiving the Chemical Engineering Masterpiece Award (化工傑作獎)!

Our Frontier Materials Research Group (FMRG) team also took part in the 72nd TwIChE Annual Meeting at National Cheng Kung University in Tainan on 29–30 November 2025. Thank you to Dr. Shih-Hsuan Chen (陳世軒), 彥璋, 翊銘, and 煥瑜 for joining Prof. Lee and Dr. Chiu to share the lab’s work.

title: Congratulations on the Bronze Medal at the 2023 Taiwan Innotech Expo!
summary: Congratulations to Prof. Kun-Mu Lee and Dr. Wei-Hao Chiu on receiving a Bronze Medal at the 2023 Taiwan Innotech Expo for their perovskite solar cell module technology!
paragraphs: Congratulations to Prof. Kun-Mu Lee and Dr. Wei-Hao Chiu on receiving a Bronze Medal at the 2023 Taiwan Innotech Expo!

In its report dated 28 December 2023, the Center for Sustainability and Energy Technologies (CSET), Chang Gung University, highlighted the team’s work on high-efficiency, high-stability perovskite solar cell modules and their potential for scalable, cost-effective energy applications.
The date shown for this news entry is the CSET report publication date, rather than the award ceremony date.
